title: Off the Main Thread (Spot Painting)
summary: A Hirst-style spot painting whose every spot is painted by a Web Worker 'studio assistant' while the main thread, the artist, is forbidden by the browser from painting any.
mechanism: Per-spot canvas.transferControlToOffscreen() handed to inline Blob Web Workers (one per navigator.hardwareConcurrency core); main-thread getContext() then throws InvalidStateError live; isolated worker memory makes the no-repeat colour rule unenforceable, tallied in RAM only, no network or storage.
references: Peter Paul Rubens / the studio workshop tradition
y-a-v-a, For the Love of Fame (2009)
y-a-v-a, Three Ball Total Equilibrium Slot Machine (2020)
